conviction_map.core_thesis: 3 — Optical & Interconnect — Largest single position (July 2026); Jensen Huang's "next trillion-dollar company"; optical/interconnect moat; in the "Coherent, Lumentum, Corning, and Marvell all in the mix" 800V DC/optical list; named in Edge Awakens long table.

conviction_map.core_thesis: 4 — Semicon (memory) — Was in/out of the book all year (sold near peak ~$700-800 early June, repurchased mid-July at 1/5 of May size, ~$850 with 200-day ~$500, target $1,500-1,600). Memory scarcity = core theme; named in every episode.

conviction_map.stance: WATCHING / HIGH-CONFIDENCE candidate (reconstructed, not independently confirmed)
conviction_map.core_thesis: 5 — Optical & Interconnect — Explicit in his optical fiber long list ("Coherent, Lumentum, Corning"); silicon photonics efficiency story for 800V DC; Indium-phosphide bottleneck angle; CEO on White House trade trip.

conviction_map.stance: WATCHING / HIGH-CONFIDENCE candidate (reconstructed, not independently confirmed)
conviction_map.core_thesis: 6 — Optical & Interconnect — Explicit in his optical fiber long list; 800V DC / photonics efficiency story; step-up function in optical earnings a stated catalyst theme.
7 — Semicon (CPU / edge) — Started buying below $110; "sees CPU/optical value"; +400% from lows per May table; CPU shortage / agentic CPU TAM $100B by 2030 thesis; edge AI pull-through.

8 — Semicon architecture — In his long semis list (Nvidia, Broadcom, Micron, Intel, TI, Marvell); "85% of S&P revisions" concentration; one of the few semis ranked in the Semicon Architecture theme above NVDA per the exhaustion report (KLAC #1, AVGO/NVDA/ASML below).

9 — Power semis / edge — Named in the long table; "critical for understanding where the cycle is heading" (industrial + edge AI + NPUs); power semis at the center of the 800V DC solution; 6-name power semi vertical in the 68-name Edge universe.

10 — Energy & Infrastructure — The IPP trade he "increased size in" as defensive AI against momentum unwind; IPP index shown as the risk-reduction sleeve; "If defense starts working in AI, you're going to see Vistra and some of these IPPs."

11 — Chemicals & Materials — On his Vera Rubin watch list ("Entegris, MKSI"); "Molecular Moat 2.0" chemistry-at-the-interface paper; chemicals = his highest-scoring theme (5 of top 12 names); consumables = capex-proof revenue.
